description: This file is a script for generating ESLint plugin configurations, rule indexes, and README documentation based on rule modules in a project.

classes.name: FoundRule
classes.description: Interface representing a rule module and its name.

classes.name: GeneratedConfig
classes.description: Interface representing a generated configuration with name and path.

methods.name: ruleDocsPath
methods.description: Retrieves the relative path to the documentation for a given rule name.

methods.name: generateConfig
methods.description: Generates a configuration file for a set of rules.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes formatted code to a specified file path.

methods.name: generateRuleIndex
methods.description: Creates an index file exporting all rules.

methods.name: generatePluginIndex
methods.description: Creates an index file exporting all configs and rules.

methods.name: generateReadme
methods.description: Updates the README with rule documentation links and descriptions.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the generation process.
